purpose: Check exact behavior parity between the old sparse gate and the selected 4 MiB slow-link chunk hook on resource pools where the admitted graph has no slow compute-to-compute edge.
decision: Each case must have identical trace, arrivals, output throughput, TTFT, TPOT, completion fraction, backlog, route counts, request samples and GPU busy fractions, with zero paused chunks. This is a smoke safety check, not a long-window performance claim.
